evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone search capability; no other backlog story is a prerequisite at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires the existence of a user profile (creation/management/data) to base search on; this dependency is not self-contained and is only implied elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having user profiles/behavior data to compute similarity between users; not self-contained within the story.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Can be delivered as a standalone similarity search given an input video; does not inherently require another story to exist first.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Uses metadata/tags but does not inherently depend on another specific backlog story being implemented first (tags could come from ingestion or existing sources).

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Defines its own capability (upload + tag persistence) without requiring another story as a prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on videos being segmented into segments before thumbnails can be shown per segment.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having video segments available (segmentation) to provide similarity info at segment level.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Requires segment-level entities to exist to compute/report perceptual similarity for segments.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having user profiles and a notion of similarity between them; not self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having the user's area/location (or profile/location settings) to determine 'my area'.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Defines a complete feature (recognition + info retrieval) without requiring another specific story as a prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained identification + information retrieval; no explicit prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained capability; does not inherently require another backlog story first.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained identification + info; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone image-to-video recommendation feature; no explicit prerequisite story in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Defines a standalone map-based browsing/notification feature; does not inherently depend on another story.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Standalone search modality; no requirement-level dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation management can be delivered as its own capability; it does not inherently require another story to exist first.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the existence of 'video segments' (segmentation) before segment-level annotation/topic extraction can occur.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone filtering/ranking feature; no explicit prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Standalone analysis feature; does not inherently depend on another story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Standalone prefiltering capability; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained prefilter/search feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Defines a standalone validation step; 'ingested contents' is a domain assumption rather than a dependency on a specific backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented independently using available metadata/tags; no inherent dependency on a specific other story.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having citizen annotations and Talk comments available to use as inputs.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Requires annotations and Talk comments to exist as inputs before prompting logic can be applied.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone classification/segmentation of volunteers; no explicit prerequisite story in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection capability; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained segmentation/localization capability; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Standalone analysis feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained analysis feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features ... in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection capability; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone weighting model using experience data; no explicit prerequisite story in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Standalone prefiltering/cleanup feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Standalone audio processing feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained clustering/grouping feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Standalone counting/detection feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone decisioning feature; no explicit prerequisite story is required at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on first deciding that an interruption should occur; otherwise the modality choice is not meaningful.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Standalone decisioning feature; no explicit prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Depends on first deciding that education should be delivered; modality selection presupposes an education trigger.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having decided to educate the volunteer (and having an education intervention context).

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Defines a standalone detection/notification capability; does not inherently require another story first.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having Zoonibot comment content/behavior defined (what it should say) to operationalize 'should comment'.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having the explanation content defined (what Zoonibot should say) to make 'give an explanation' actionable.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained content-selection/generation requirement; does not inherently require another story first.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Standalone grouping/clustering feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having recorded/available volunteer previous experiences to base recommendations on.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone summarization/view feature; no explicit prerequisite story in the backlog.
